title: Define Red Flag Patterns for SCP Boundary Violations
decision: Publish a red-flag taxonomy that identifies common drift patterns leading to SCP constraint violations.
context: Many boundary violations occur through gradual drift and plausible deniability rather than explicit intent.
rationale: Naming violation patterns makes boundary crossings visible and harder to deny.
consequences: Teams gain a shared language to recognize and prevent constraint erosion.
scp_risk_notes: Constraint boundaries require operational red flags to remain visible over time.
